mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.category_id, c.name AS category_name, q.difficulty, q.view_count, q.practice_count, q.published_at FROM question q JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id
ORDER BY q.practice_count DESC, q.id DESC
ORDER BY q.published_at DESC, q.id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.content_md, q.answer_md, q.difficulty, q.category_id, c.name AS category_name, q.view_count, q.practice_count, q.published_at FROM question q JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id WHERE q.id = #{id} AND q.deleted = 0 AND q.status = 1
SELECT id FROM question WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND id < #{id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM question WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND id > #{id} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT self_assess FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
